_comment: EXAMPLE, NOT APPLIED. Nothing reads this outside scripts/relay-worker-preflight.py. vm.kubevirt and vm.compose are qualified by the KubeVirt spike of 2026-11-09 to 11-10, for the KubeVirt pins below only (docs/relay-workers/kubevirt-spike-record-2026-11-09.md). Every other capability is unqualified. Values marked null are unresolved operator decisions, which the collector reports as unknown.

placement._comment: Dedicated-pool only. relay (incl. relay-postgres, staging) and llm-router (incl. llm-router-edge) are the namespaces kubernetes/apps/apps/{relay,llm-router} deploy to; none may run on the worker pool.

developer_vm._comment: One 4 vCPU / 8 GiB developer VM with a 20 GiB cache disk. Measured in the spike (S2, s2-launcher-pod.json): the virt-launcher pod's effective scheduler request is 4.025 CPU, 8.57 GiB memory (8 GiB guest, 486 Mi KubeVirt overhead, 100 M of helper containers) and 30.09 GiB ephemeral storage. The ephemeral figure is the VM spec's declared 30Gi plus KubeVirt's two fixed 50M containerDisk requests, not the image size, so an image refresh does not change it; a different VM shape or KubeVirt pin does. cpu and memory keep about 1 CPU and 1.4 GiB of margin; ephemeral storage is the request rounded up.

vm.kubevirt._comment: Spike S1-S3 and S5-S9 on relay-worker-1, 2026-11-09 to 11-10. receipt_sha256 is the digest of the evidence set's SHA256SUMS. S8 passed with deviation D5, accepted by the owner: neither soak run reached 8 hours. Before any install, check cert-manager's cainjector headroom (F15; its limit is raised in #1701). Open: F12 (the worker's disk I/O shares a control-plane node's NVMe). A change to either KubeVirt pin needs a new qualification.

vm.compose._comment: Spike S4 (one Compose stack with Postgres, Redis, an app and load generators, inside the VM) and the 20 S8 cycles, same evidence set. Same conditions as vm.kubevirt.

repository.push._comment: no expiry-enforcing forge broker yet (plan: no push in the Kubernetes pilot)
